note: Nine complete building sheets cover both basements, ground, three podium levels, floor 1, grouped floors 2–17 and the roof. A separate 27 November 2025 document supplies the original 3 BR unit 1101 drawing. Its page 2 states 1,264.76 sq ft suite plus 353.49 sq ft balcony, totalling 1,618.25 sq ft. This historical example does not establish current inventory. Three attributed broker studio previews show no numerical area. Confirm other homes and final revisions with Imtiaz.
